From 530e3d4af566ca44807d79359b90794dea24c4f3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Suchit Karunakaran <suchitkarunakaran@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Dec 2025 22:44:34 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] btrfs: fix NULL pointer dereference in do_abort_log_replay()

Coverity reported a NULL pointer dereference issue (CID 1666756) in
do_abort_log_replay(). When btrfs_alloc_path() fails in
replay_one_buffer(), wc->subvol_path is NULL, but btrfs_abort_log_replay()
calls do_abort_log_replay() which unconditionally dereferences
wc->subvol_path when attempting to print debug information. Fix this by
adding a NULL check before dereferencing wc->subvol_path in
do_abort_log_replay().

Fixes: 2753e4917624 ("btrfs: dump detailed info and specific messages on log replay failures")
Reviewed-by: Filipe Manana <fdmanana@suse.com>
Signed-off-by: Suchit Karunakaran <suchitkarunakaran@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Filipe Manana <fdmanana@suse.com>
Signed-off-by: David Sterba <dsterba@suse.com>

diff --git a/fs/btrfs/tree-log.c b/fs/btrfs/tree-log.c
index 5831754bb01c..2d9d38b82daa 100644
--- a/fs/btrfs/tree-log.c
+++ b/fs/btrfs/tree-log.c
@@ -190,7 +190,7 @@ static void do_abort_log_replay(struct walk_control *wc, const char *function,
 
 	btrfs_abort_transaction(wc->trans, error);
 
-	if (wc->subvol_path->nodes[0]) {
+	if (wc->subvol_path && wc->subvol_path->nodes[0]) {
 		btrfs_crit(fs_info,
 			   "subvolume (root %llu) leaf currently being processed:",
 			   btrfs_root_id(wc->root));
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a NULL pointer dereference bug in `do_abort_log_replay()` within `fs/btrfs/tree-log.c`.

### Modifications in each file

- **fs/btrfs/tree-log.c** – Line 190:  
  Changed the condition from  
  `if (wc->subvol_path->nodes[0])`  
  to  
  `if (wc->subvol_path && wc->subvol_path->nodes[0])`.  
  This adds a NULL check for `wc->subvol_path` before accessing its `nodes[0]` member.

### Relationship of modifications

The NULL check directly addresses the root cause of the bug: when `btrfs_alloc_path()` fails inside `replay_one_buffer()`, `wc->subvol_path` is left as `NULL`. Previously, the unconditional dereference `wc->subvol_path->nodes[0]` would cause a NULL pointer dereference. The added guard ensures that the dereference only occurs if `wc->subvol_path` is non‑NULL, thus preventing the crash while preserving the intended debug printing behavior when the path is valid.

Here is the commit message:
btrfs: fix NULL pointer dereference in do_abort_log_replay()

Coverity reported a NULL pointer dereference issue (CID 1666756) in
do_abort_log_replay(). When btrfs_alloc_path() fails in
replay_one_buffer(), wc->subvol_path is NULL, but btrfs_abort_log_replay()
calls do_abort_log_replay() which unconditionally dereferences
wc->subvol_path when attempting to print debug information. Fix this by
adding a NULL check before dereferencing wc->subvol_path in
do_abort_log_replay().

Fixes: 2753e4917624 ("btrfs: dump detailed info and specific messages on log replay failures")
Reviewed-by: Filipe Manana <fdmanana@suse.com>
Signed-off-by: Suchit Karunakaran <suchitkarunakaran@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Filipe Manana <fdmanana@suse.com>
Signed-off-by: David Sterba <dsterba@suse.com>

Here is the root cause:
In do_abort_log_replay(), wc->subvol_path is dereferenced without a NULL check, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when btrfs_alloc_path() fails in replay_one_buffer() and leaves wc->subvol_path as NULL.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void do_abort_log_replay(struct walk_control *wc, const char *function,
 				unsigned int line, int error, const char *fmt, ...)
 {
 	struct btrfs_fs_info *fs_info = wc->trans->fs_info;
 	struct va_format vaf;
 	va_list args;
 
 	/*
 	 * Do nothing if we already aborted, to avoid dumping leaves again which
 	 * can be verbose. Further more, only the first call is useful since it
 	 * is where we have a problem. Note that we do not use the flag
 	 * BTRFS_FS_STATE_TRANS_ABORTED because log replay calls functions that
 	 * are outside of tree-log.c that can abort transactions (such as
 	 * btrfs_add_link() for example), so if that happens we still want to
 	 * dump all log replay specific information below.
 	 */
 	if (test_and_set_bit(BTRFS_FS_STATE_LOG_REPLAY_ABORTED, &fs_info->fs_state))
 		return;
 
 	btrfs_abort_transaction(wc->trans, error);
 
-	if (wc->subvol_path->nodes[0]) {
+	if (wc->subvol_path && wc->subvol_path->nodes[0]) {
 		btrfs_crit(fs_info,
 			   "subvolume (root %llu) leaf currently being processed:",
 			   btrfs_root_id(wc->root));
 		btrfs_print_leaf(wc->subvol_path->nodes[0]);
 	}
 
 	if (wc->log_leaf) {
 		btrfs_crit(fs_info,
 "log tree (for root %llu) leaf currently being processed (slot %d key " BTRFS_KEY_FMT "):",
 			   btrfs_root_id(wc->root), wc->log_slot,
 			   BTRFS_KEY_FMT_VALUE(&wc->log_key));
 		btrfs_print_leaf(wc->log_leaf);
 	}
 
 	va_start(args, fmt);
 	vaf.fmt = fmt;
 	vaf.va = &args;
 
 	btrfs_crit(fs_info,
 	   "log replay failed in %s:%u for root %llu, stage %d, with error %d: %pV",
 		   function, line, btrfs_root_id(wc->root), wc->stage, error, &vaf);
 
 	va_end(args);
 }
